steps.caption:
That "I'm fine" wasn't a lie. It was armor.
When social anxiety turns every room into a test, looking fine feels safer than explaining the tight chest and the blank mind. You time the laugh, you hold the eye contact, you say the line so no one asks twice.
If you perform fine at work while falling apart inside, you're not alone. You're not distant. You're just tired of being misread. Comment MASK and I'll send you the full breakdown.
